bind_address.description: IP address the HTTP tunnel server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

bind_port.description: Port number the server listens on for incoming HTTP tunnel requests.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections the server accepts.

compression.description: Enable gzip compression of the tunneled payload to reduce bandwidth.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to standard error.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before an idle connection is closed (0 = no timeout).

auth_type.description: Authentication method: 'none' (no auth) or 'file' (user:password lines in auth_file).

auth_file.description: Path to the file containing user:password credentials (used only when auth_type='file').

forward_address.description: Destination host (IP or hostname) where tunneled traffic is forwarded.

forward_port.description: Destination port for forwarded traffic (e.g., 22 for SSH, 80 for HTTP).

allowed_ips.description: List of IP addresses allowed to connect (if empty, all IPs allowed).

denied_ips.description: List of IP addresses explicitly denied, overriding allow list.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the HTTP tunnel connection.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enabled=true.

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enabled=true.

ssl_ciphers.description: TLS cipher suite list, colon- or comma-separated. Defaults to modern secure ciphers.

daemonize.description: Run as a background daemon (recommended for production).

pid_file.description: Path to write the daemon's PID file (used only if daemonize=true).
